about_the_game:
Have you ever wanted to go to the moon and play pogo stick?

At first, you'll think this game is hard.

But once you get the hang of it, you'll realize it's really hard.

But the difficulty is limited, and the human heart always has the habit of magnifying the unknown difficulty into the infinite.

If you are happy in your life, you can try this game, maybe it can make you “twice as happy”.

If you are in a low point, then you can also try this game, because I also made this game in the low point period!

Or if you're just bored, try this game that took me half a year to make because of an impulse.

People are childish when facing the world

Facing the universe, ideals all seem small

bro Z is like a knight rushing towards a windmill

Going all out for a fantasized goal

The operation of the game is very simple, move the character left and right, press the space bar in the air, store the power downward, and release it before landing, the faster the speed of impact on the ground, the higher the height of the bounce. Please feel free to jump.

Encouraged by the NPC's “encouragement”, climb upwards bravely.

Feel the level design full of “kindness” and more hidden elements waiting for you to explore.

Collect gold coins to unlock NPC's Character Illustration, but be careful, you need to deposit the coins into the ATM to use them.

The Character Illustration unlocking system is made to be a card draw function, maybe will give you some “motivation” to break through the levels.

If you're feeling a bit lost and frustrated at the moment, maybe you can find some empathy in this, because the author is also very lost，LOL.

Those who are proficient in Newtonian mechanics may be able to calculate how high a pole vault can jump on the moon.

But bro Z doesn't want to do the calculate, he just wants to go up there and experience it for himself

Once he actually arrives, the fantasy is no longer a fantasy but a real hope

short_description: This is a medium-high difficulty platform jumping Meta game, and unlike its predecessors in those categories, The biggest feature of this game is that when you fall at high speed, you will bottom out and bounce back. Experience the joy of going up and down.
